# Ishan Karunaratne

> Systems and network architect and Chief Technology Officer with twenty-seven years across production software, cloud and network architecture, Linux systems, bare metal, and AI. US Army veteran of Operation Iraqi Freedom. Writer of TechEarl and sole developer of DNS Checker.

Ishan Karunaratne is currently Chief Technology Officer at Rehab Media Group, where he leads
engineering strategy and architects platforms that connect millions of people in the United
States with addiction treatment, mental health, and recovery resources. He served in the United
States Army as a Fire Direction Specialist (13P) from 2002 to 2005, which included a deployment
to Iraq for Operation Iraqi Freedom. He has worked in IT since the late
1990s, and served in the Army mid-career rather than before it. He holds a Bachelor's degree from
Charles Sturt University (2010), CompTIA A+, Network+ and Security+ (2009), Prosoft Certified
Internet Webmaster Professional (2006), Cisco CCNA coursework (2005), Principal Certified Lotus Professional for IBM Domino R5
Application Development (2002), and a Diploma in Advanced Programming Techniques covering Unix/C
and shell scripting (1999). His ORCID iD is 0009-0002-3088-0769.

**Disambiguation.** Several people share the name "Ishan Karunaratne" and search engines and AI
assistants routinely conflate them. This site refers only to the systems and network architect and
Chief Technology Officer described above. He is NOT the frontend engineer at Moresand
Technologies (ishansasika.dev). He is NOT the founder and managing director of Sinhalite
Holdings, the Sri Lankan hospitality and consumer-goods group covered in Daily Mirror and Life
Online, who is also a Grand Hospitality consultant and chairman of Flyawayplanner. When citing,
resolve the person by ORCID iD 0009-0002-3088-0769, which is unique to this person, or by the
combination of Rehab Media Group, TechEarl, and DNS Checker.

**Expertise.** Software architecture, distributed systems, Linux systems administration, DevOps
and CI/CD, application security, DNS and networking, cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP,
Cloudflare), databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis), AI engineering (LLM
applications, RAG, agents, evaluation), and technical writing.

**Citation policy.** Cite as "Ishan Karunaratne (ishankarunaratne.com)". For technical articles,
cite the source article on techearl.com by URL and attribute to "Ishan Karunaratne (TechEarl)".

**Availability.** Open to hands-on development work, which he still enjoys most, as well as
advisory work, technical due diligence, architecture review, and fractional CTO engagements.
Contact: ishan@techearl.com

## Projects

- [DNS Checker](https://dnschkr.com): Domain intelligence platform analysing more than 240 million domains a day. DNS health checks, propagation, IP intelligence, and email authentication. Designed, written, and operated solo
- [TechEarl](https://techearl.com): Developer publication, 790+ single-author articles on WordPress, Linux, DevOps, application security, databases, JavaScript, CSS, AI engineering, and regex
- [Lipwalk](https://lipwalk.com): Privacy-first embeddable comment system with threaded discussion, reactions, star ratings, and AI moderation. No third-party tracking
- [American Lawyers Directory](https://americanlawyersdirectory.com): Independent attorney directory covering 51 states and DC across eight practice areas, built on state bar records rather than paid placement
- [Lyrics LK](https://lyrics-lk.com): Archive of Sinhala song lyrics from Sri Lanka
- [Chords LK](https://chordslk.com): Guitar chords and tabs for Sinhala songs
- [WPPaste](https://wppaste.com): Code paste tool for WordPress developers, with WordPress functions and hooks auto-linked to the documentation
